resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; no document, glyph or pixel payload in either direction.

semantics: Bounded PNG resource and placement import only. A required placement intent creates a still layer or places on an authored frame atomically, with one revision/history entry and canonical native asset ID/dimensions/target. Catalog-only attach retains compatibility validation but refuses unavailable before source I/O. The current lifecycleGeneration is not a constant: it advances on every project New/Open/replacement, so read it from nemo_discover instances[].nativeHostStatus.lifecycleGeneration (or the Tauri client status) immediately before a placed attach (only a placement carries it); example values are illustrative only, and a stale value is refused as unavailable before any source work. Other codecs, sequences, DOM drop handles and video remain unavailable. Catalog removal is declared separately. This declaration covers only the bounded PNG placement route; installed acceptance and full media parity are recorded separately.
